title: Exact calibration of structural models via time-change
abstract: arXiv:2609.12666v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this note, we propose a general structural approach to model a default time $\tau$ as the first-passage time (FPT) of a (``firm-value'') process $S$ below a (``debt'') barrier $K$ that comply with a pre-specified survival probability curve $G(t)=\Pr(\tau>t)$. Following an idea of Mbaye and Vrins (Mathematical Finance, 2022) applied to reduced-form models, our approach consists in two steps: choose a latent FPT model driven by a barrier $\tilde{K}$ and process $\tilde{S}$, and time-change those using a deterministic clock $\Theta$ to get $K_t=\tilde{K}_{\Theta(t)}$ and $S_t:=\tilde{S}_{\Theta(t)}$, leading to the final FTP model $(K,S,\Theta)$. As the market curve $G$ and the latent model $(\tilde{K},\tilde{S})$ are assumed to be given, the calibration step simply consists in finding the clock $\Theta$ such that the distribution of the FPT of $S$ below $K$ coincides with the survival curve $G$. translated_title: 基于时间变换的结构模型精确校准
translated_abstract: 本文提出一种通用的结构化方法，将违约时间 τ 建模为（“公司价值”）过程 S 首次跌破（“债务”）障碍 K 的首达时间（FPT），并使之符合预先指定的生存概率曲线 G(t)=Pr(τ>t)。借鉴 Mbaye 和 Vrins（Mathematical Finance, 2022）应用于简约式模型的思想，我们的方法包含两个步骤：首先选择一个由障碍 K̃ 和过程 S̃ 驱动的潜在首达时间模型，然后利用确定性时钟 Θ 对其进行时间变换，得到 K_t=K̃_{Θ(t)} 和 S_t:=S̃_{Θ(t)}，从而构成最终的首达时间模型 (K,S,Θ)。由于市场曲线 G 和潜在模型 (K̃,S̃) 均假设为给定，校准步骤仅仅在于寻找时钟 Θ，使得 S 首次跌破 K 的分布与生存曲线 G 相吻合。我们证明了这对于一大类模型是可行的……
tldr: 本文提出通过确定性时间变换时钟对潜在首达时间模型进行变换，使其违约时间分布精确匹配市场给定的生存概率曲线，从而实现结构模型的精确校准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structural approach that achieves exact calibration to a pre-specified survival probability curve by applying a deterministic time-change clock to a latent first-passage-time default model.
